description: Headline integration: markup opcode + typed inline channels + parameterized tree macros + sidecar feature extraction (10 features) + cmix back-end + integer SSM stub. Targets S < 100,000,000 (10% of input) with the cmix C++ mixer integration completed.

layers.L2_typed_inline_channels: 6 structural states; inline marker bytes (escape 0x01); no stream split
layers.L3_tree_macros: structural shape hash; RePair-class admission; arguments stay literal (escape 0x03)
layers.L4_sidecar_features: 10 features computed deterministically; exposed via compute_sidecar_features(); not yet consumed by cmix mixer
layers.L6_integer_ssm: stub at integer_ssm_step(); int16 state, deterministic update, cross-host SHA256 contract

honest_gates_for_10_percent: cmix C++ source modified to accept the 10 sidecar feature streams as additional context families
Layer 6 integer SSM wired as one cmix mixer family, with integer matmul + cross-host byte-equal contract
Phase 2 ablation confirms markup opcode helps cmix (not just xz)
Phase 5 ablation confirms tree macros over parsed templates net-positive on cmix
kill_conditions: cross-host SHA256 mismatch on any layer
patch_fraction or macro_coverage diagnostics indicate net-negative contribution
score_accounting_note: imports cmix_wrapped/program.py via sys.path; for contest submission the cmix binary must be inlined here too
